findings.title: doc-lint CI gate fails — 19 frontmatter violations across 10 docs/**/*.md files
findings.evidence: Running the frontmatter validator embedded in .github/workflows/doc-lint.yml produced 19 errors: missing blocks on 6 files, missing required fields on 3 files, and 3 files using status='Current' which is not in the valid set.
findings.impact: Every PR that touches docs/ would fail the doc-lint job. New contributors can't merge doc updates until this is fixed.
findings.recommendation: Add the required frontmatter block (title, owner, status, last_reviewed) to each non-compliant file, replacing the legacy prd-version/last-updated/status='Current' schema while preserving existing data.
remediationPlan: Add full frontmatter to 6 files that had none (ARCHITECTURE, DEPLOYMENT, RUNBOOK, SECURITY, TEST_STRATEGY, ADR/001)
Add missing fields to 3 files with wrong schema (DEVELOPMENT, MANIFEST, ROADMAP)
Add last_reviewed to PRD.md (had everything else)
Re-run the validator and confirm 0 errors

findings.title: CHANGELOG.md v1.0.0 claims robots.txt and sitemap.xml exist, but both files are absent on disk
standardsBasis: docs/TEST_STRATEGY.md SEO targets — minimum Lighthouse SEO ≥ 90 requires robots.txt + sitemap.xml
findings.evidence: CHANGELOG line 14 claims '- robots.txt and sitemap.xml'. `find . -name robots.txt -o -name sitemap.xml` returns nothing. SEO crawlers therefore have no crawl directives and no sitemap discovery — directly contradicts the v1.0.0 release notes.
findings.impact: Search engines crawl the site without guidance; new articles are indexed slowly. Trust gap between CHANGELOG and actual repo state for any future contributor or auditor.
findings.recommendation: Create both files at repo root with the canonical site URL (https://migar-git.github.io/aresmax-blog/) and the seven content URLs (index, store, unsubscribe excluded from crawl, five articles).
remediationPlan: Write robots.txt with Allow:/ + Disallow:/unsubscribe.html + Sitemap directive
Write sitemap.xml listing all 7 indexable pages with 2026-05-12 lastmod

findings.title: Two portfolio repos failed to fetch during /agency-repo-sync — veon, vfta
standardsBasis: agency-repo-sync skill exits non-zero when any repo fails
findings.evidence: Sync output: 'WARN fetch failed veon' and 'WARN fetch failed vfta'. 48 other repos came up CLEAN.
findings.impact: Two repos are stale relative to remote. Could be network hiccup, auth (private repo with rotated token), or repo renamed/deleted on GitHub.
findings.recommendation: Owner should run `cd ~/DEV/veon && git fetch -v` and `cd ~/DEV/vfta && git fetch -v` to surface the underlying error (auth/404/network).
remediationPlan: Re-run fetch with -v in each repo
If 404: check if the repo was renamed or made private

findings.title: CSP allows 'unsafe-inline' for script-src — XSS hardening opportunity
standardsBasis: docs/SECURITY.md acknowledges this and notes 'tighten to nonce if possible'
findings.evidence: CSP includes `script-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'`. For a static GitHub Pages site with no server, nonces cannot be generated per-request — this is a documented constraint, not a defect.
findings.impact: If an attacker could inject HTML (which they can't on a static site that takes no user input), they could execute inline JS. Real-world risk is negligible because there is no user-controlled content path.
findings.recommendation: Document the constraint in SECURITY.md (already done) and move inline scripts to external files where practical. Revisit if a server-rendered surface is ever added.

findings.title: No local pre-commit hook for markdownlint / frontmatter checks — drift can re-occur
standardsBasis: doc-lint workflow runs in CI but not pre-commit; nothing prevents F-0001 from happening again
findings.evidence: There is no `.pre-commit-config.yaml` in the repo. Frontmatter and markdown drift only surfaces at PR time, after work is already done.
findings.impact: Easy to re-introduce the same class of error F-0001 fixed.
findings.recommendation: Add a `.pre-commit-config.yaml` that runs `markdownlint-cli2` + the embedded Python frontmatter check. Out of scope for this iteration; tracked as follow-up.
